messages:
harper (partnerships): CipherNest reached out — they want a joint marketplace launch and an integration listing. Scope: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, secrets sync via their hosted HSM (they call it NestHSM), and optional webhook audit forwarding. Can we split owners and list blockers? :slightly_smiling_face:

ajay (security): I can lead the HSM/KMS validation. Need: NestHSM attestation, key-wrap API (wrap/unwrap), supported algorithms, and a read-only test key for wrap ops. Also request their incident response contact and rotation cadence.

ryan (eng): I'll own SAML and runtime glue. Please send IdP metadata, sample SAML responses, expected ACS URLs, and recommended NameID format. I'll add a toggled CI smoke test for our install flow.

dina (product): I'll take SCIM + install UX. Need SCIM schema, whether they support PATCH/delta, bulk import behavior, and group mapping expectations. Also want a promo screenshot of admin settings.

ciphernest-ps: We support SCIM PATCH, full import, and groups. NestHSM is a hosted FIPS-capable HSM. We'll share attestation and a sandbox. ETA: artifacts by Tue EOD.

julia (legal): We'll need logo assets, brand guidelines, and any required legal copy for the marketplace. Also ask them to send a DPA draft if they want customer data flows documented.

harper (partnerships): Proposed timeline: Tue artifacts, Wed security call, next Mon dry-run, Apr 30 announce. Is that feasible?

ajay (security): Sounds OK. Quick test snippet for them to run and paste output (wrap check):

curl -X POST https://sandbox.ciphernest.com/kms/wrap \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"key_id":"test-wrap","plaintext":"SGVsbG8="}'

We will verify unwrap returns original plaintext and that wrapped blob length meets expectation.

ryan (eng): SCIM example we'll use for smoke tests:
POST /scim/v2/Users
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{ "userName": "m.lee", "displayName": "M Lee", "emails": [{"value":"m.lee@ciphernest.com"}] }

Also please include SCIM rate-limit behavior and sample 429 body.

ciphernest-ps: We'll provide IdP metadata, SCIM sandbox creds, attestation PDF, logo, and rate-limit docs by Tue EOD. Embargo: Apr 30 07:00 PT.

dina (product): Action items for docs: short blurb (1 line), long blurb (3-4 lines), tags (SAML, SCIM, KMS), install steps, and one admin UI screenshot. I'll draft blurbs once I get the screenshot.

julia (legal): Also confirm whether the partner wants joint press or just marketplace announcement. If joint press, we need legal copy and trademark approvals earlier.

harper (partnerships): I'll coordinate press ask. I'll schedule the security call once ajay confirms avail. docs-bot: created draft listing stub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-integrations/pull/721

ciphernest-ps: Confirmed. We'll aim to hit Tue EOD and stand by for the security call. Thanks everyone.

harper (partnerships): Great — summary: partner -> artifacts Tue EOD; ajay -> threat-model Wed; ryan -> add SAML/SCIM smoke tests; dina -> marketplace copy + screenshot; julia -> legal review. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
